name: Octopus.do
description:
Plan and edit a website's structure just by describing it.

Octopus.do is a visual sitemap tool. Tell Claude what you're building — "a coffee subscription shop with a store, plans, a blog and a contact page" — and it lays out the sitemap for you: every page in place, nested the way it should be, with wireframe blocks sketching what goes on each one.

Already have a project? Ask about it in plain language: what pages exist, how the structure is organised, what's on a given page. Then change it — add a pricing page under Products, move a whole section somewhere else, reorder things, clear out what you don't need. A big restructure happens in one step instead of dozens of clicks.

Handy when you're scoping a new site, reworking an old one, or putting structure together to show a client or hand over to a developer. Works with both your own projects and your team's.

You connect your own octopus.do account, and Claude only ever sees the projects that account can already open.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Octopus.do to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Octopus.do to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.octopus.do/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Octopus.do MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Octopus.do lists 17 MCP tools, including apply_changes, create_block, create_node, create_project, delete_block, delete_node, get_me, get_project, get_workspace, list_projects, list_workspaces, and manage_project.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Octopus.do?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Octopus.do in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Octopus.do requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Octopus.do is developed by SIA Scada. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
